Why businesses choose us

  • Printed GC (goods consignment) receipt for every booking

What we do

Transport services

From a single bundle to a full truck, we book, carry and deliver it with clear paperwork.

📦

Parcel & part load

Bags, boxes, cartons, rolls and bundles booked at any branch and delivered to the destination godown.

🚛

Full truck load

Dedicated vehicles for larger consignments, with a lorry receipt (LR) listing every GC on board.

🏠

Door delivery

Goods delivered from our godown to the consignee's door, with a delivery slip for every round.

🧾

Flexible payment

Pay at booking (Paid), let the receiver pay (To Pay), or get billed later (To be Billed) for regular customers.

📄

E-way bill support

E-way bill and invoice details recorded on the GC so your goods move with the right documents.

💬

WhatsApp updates

Consignors receive their GC receipt as a PDF on WhatsApp as soon as the booking is saved.

How it works

Three simple steps

1

Book at a branch

Bring your goods to any Sabri Logistics branch. We weigh them and record consignor, consignee and charges.

2

Get your GC receipt

You get a printed GC receipt with its GC number, and a copy on WhatsApp if you share your number.

3

Delivered

Goods travel on our trucks to the destination branch and are handed over or delivered to the door.

About us

A Veraval transport company that keeps its paperwork straight

Sabri Logistics is a goods transport company headquartered in Veraval (Gir-Somnath), Gujarat. We serve traders, manufacturers and shops who send goods between Saurashtra, Surat and Ahmedabad every day.

Every consignment gets a GC number and a printed receipt in three copies (consignor, consignee and driver). Our branches use one system for bookings, lorry receipts, inward records and delivery slips, so a consignment can always be traced.
